alt: a morning-lit corner with potted plants at varying heights on wood surfaces, showing blooming growth and visible root development, arranged with terracotta, ceramic, and natural materials
text:
weeks of tending in silence. then one morning: a flower.

the room holds this waiting. wood surfaces at different heights. light arriving as it does. terracotta warming, ceramic catching condensation from days ago. visible root threads reaching.

the blooming moment is so quiet you could miss it when it finally comes.
